_about: Agency M3 prompt test set. Each case is a draft with the facts the copywriter was given and the verdict the deterministic brand review must reach. tests/test_marketing_prompt_eval.py runs every case in CI; scripts/marketing_prompt_eval.py runs the live copywriter on the briefs and grades its drafts with the same checks. Dummy business only.
